audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart read Naafiri on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Two layers gave opposite answers to every row.
audit.why: Hwei's QQ paints from beyond Darkin Daggers' 900 range and Naafiri has no lock-on until 6, so levels 1-3 are Hwei's; Eviscerate reaching 8s and the pack growing makes 4-5 genuinely even; after first item Hwei's burst re-takes it. The packet chart matches that shape.
audit.corrected: Full-layer phases[N].side moved to match the packet and content chart on all seven rows; the phases[N].why text already described Hwei winning each stage, so why/side/win now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text describes 'Q stacks' and 'stacking Q dogs' — Darkin Daggers does not stack packmates. It throws up to two daggers that bleed, doing bonus damage into an existing bleed; the packmates come from We Are More (P).
audit.why: Riot's text on Q is explicit about bleed and bonus-into-bleed, with packmates leaping to the first champion hit. Nothing in the kit stacks.
audit.corrected: Spikes and whys rewritten around the real spikes: Eviscerate's cooldown dropping to 7s, and Hounds' Pursuit at 110/95/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Naafiri ability was named anywhere, and the single most important interaction — that The Call of the Pack (W), Eviscerate (E) and Hounds' Pursuit (R) all grant untargetability — was absent entirely.
audit.why: Every Hwei damage source is a projectile paint with a travel or delay window. If it is in flight while Naafiri is untargetable, the commit is spent for nothing, and Hounds' Pursuit's second cast then grants her a shield on top. Hwei has no dash, so a whiffed rotation into a 900-range lock-on is a death.
audit.corrected: tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the spikes now state the untargetable window, the recast shield, and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t told you to buy anti-heal early 'into his sustain'. Naafiri has no self-heal in her kit.
audit.why: Riot's Eviscerate text reads that she dashes, damages, and recalls her packmates, 'fully healing them'. The heal is on the packmates, not on Naafiri. The derived heal flag misfires here, and per the brief's own rule the description wins.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal advice replaced with a statement that Eviscerate heals her pack, not her.

audit.whatIsWrong: 23 misgender hits (Naafiri called he/his/him) plus two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit.
audit.why: Naafiri is female per champ-gender.js; the bled bullets restate tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their titles; real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.
